name: Abandon a Friend
description: When an allied creature falls to 0 hit points or dies, as a reaction, you can Dash away from combat, with a +30 ft. bonus to movement speed for this reaction only.

name: Above All
description: Gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You always hover 5 feet off the ground.

name: Adapting Defenses
description: When you take damage of any type, after the damage is calculated and applied, you gain resistance to that damage type until the end of your next turn.

name: Adept Elementalist
description: Select one damage type. Increase damage done with the chosen damage type by +1 damage die and gain resistance to the chosen damage type.

name: Adept Sensory Shinobi
description: If a creature has chakra and is within 10 miles of you, you can sense it and know its general location.

name: Adhesive
description: You can adhere to anything you touch. As an action, you can choose to automatically grapple any object or creature within your unarmed attack range. Creatures grappled in this way make their contested checks to escape with disadvantage.

name: Advanced Study
description: You know jutsu up to 1 rank higher than your current limitations.

name: Aggressive
description: When an allied creature is adjacent to a hostile creature you are adjacent to, gain a 1d4 bonus to damage rolls.

name: Agile Wits
description: Select either Dexterity or Intelligence. The chosen ability score gains a 1d4 bonus to its saving throws and ability checks.

name: Alarm
description: When you take damage, all other adversaries within 100 ft. are aware of your pain.

name: Amorphous
description: You can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. Additionally, you make checks or saves to escape the Restrained or Grappled condition with advantage.

name: Aura: Damaging
description: Creatures that begin their turns within 10 feet of you take damage equal to your level.

name: Aura: Destabilized Chakra Field
description: Hostile creatures within 10 feet casting a C-Rank or lower jutsu must succeed on a check (DC 8 + your level) using their casting modifier. On a failure, the jutsu fails and the chakra is still spent.

name: Aura: Frightening Aura
description: Hostile creatures within 10 ft. must make a Wisdom saving throw against your highest save DC. On a failure, they gain 1 rank of Fear. A feared creature remakes this save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Backstab
description: If you have advantage on your attack, add your level in extra damage to the triggering attack.

name: Barbed Hide
description: At the start of your turns, deal your level in piercing, bludgeoning, or slashing damage to any creature that you are currently grappling.

name: Believe It!
description: Once per encounter, gain advantage on all attack rolls, ability checks, or saving throws until the end of your next turn.

name: Bestowed Strength
keywords: Attack, Defense, Control, Mobility, Utility, Buff, General
description: This adversary has been given the power of another, stronger adversary who is Iconic, Elite, or Solo. Gain one trait that adversary has, regardless of what it is.

name: Blood Frenzy
description: +1d4 to melee attack rolls against any creature that has 50% or fewer of its hit points.

name: Bloodthirsty
description: When a hostile creature scores a critical hit against this adversary, this adversary can immediately make a weapon attack against the triggering creature. On a hit, it automatically scores a critical hit.

name: Brutal Brawler
description: All melee weapon attacks gain +1 bonus damage die.

name: Can't Hold Me Down
description: Advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to end the Restrained, Grappled, or Prone conditions.

name: Chakra Efficiency
description: Jutsu cost is reduced to the previous rank's cost (S-Rank: 20, A-Rank: 14, B-Rank: 9, C-Rank: 5, D-Rank: 2).

name: Chakra Weapons
description: Your weapons are considered chakra-enhanced. Gain a bonus to hit and damage equal to 1/6th of your level.

name: Charger
description: If you moved more than half your maximum movement in a straight line toward your target, make your melee attack roll with advantage. On a hit, knock your target prone.

name: Clone Adept
description: Clones you summon gain access to all General Traits you have.

name: Clone Defense
description: When an allied creature would take damage while within 20 feet of a clone, as a reaction, swap places with the original target and the clone.

name: Clone Expert
description: Clones you summon gain access to all Clan Traits you have.

name: Clone Master
description: Clones you summon gain access to all Role Traits you have.

name: Combat Medic
description: Twice per combat, when you deal damage with a jutsu with the Medical keyword, you can choose to deal maximum damage.

name: Combat Seal Weaving
description: When a hostile creature fails a saving throw against a jutsu you cast by 10 or more, add your level to the damage.

name: Corrosive Body
description: When a creature touches or damages you with a melee attack, it takes 2d6 acid damage. Weapons used to strike you suffer a cumulative -1 to damage rolls. At -5, the weapon is destroyed. Mending removes all penalties.

name: Critical Fury
description: All attacks you make gain +1 to critical threat range.

name: Cunning Action
description: Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.

name: Damage Absorption
description: Select one damage type. Gain immunity to it and gain HP equal to the original damage taken. If an attack ignores immunity or resistance to the chosen type, this trait has no effect.

name: Damage Transfer
description: Allied creatures within 15 ft. take half damage; you take the other half. If you and allies would be hit by the same area-of-effect, everyone within 15 ft. (including you) takes only half damage.

name: Dangerous Body
description: When damaged in melee, all creatures within 5 feet of you take 3d6 necrotic damage.

name: Dirty Tricks
description: As a reaction to a creature within 15 ft. making a melee attack, force it to make a Wisdom (Perception) check against your Dexterity (Sleight of Hand). On a failure, it is Blinded until the end of its next turn.

name: Dragon Fist
description: As a reaction, mark a creature for 1 minute. That creature suffers a 1d4 penalty to AC against your unarmed attacks until the end of your current turn.

name: Drunken Fist
description: When you are targeted by an attack, you can take the Dodge action as a reaction and move 10 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity.

name: Durable
description: Hit points increased by 30%. (Manually update U12 with this multiplier.)
notes: "U12" refers to a cell in the companion Adversary Builder spreadsheet; kept as printed.

name: Eight Inner Gates (1)
description: 1 action: Activate the Eight Inner Gates (1). Increase your Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers by +1. (Can be ended as a bonus action or when unconscious.)

name: Eight Inner Gates (2)
description: *Must have Eight Inner Gates (1) active. As a bonus action, activate your Eight Inner Gates (2), ending Inner Gates (1). Gain +5 bonus points to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution, double speed, and gain an additional action. At the start of each of the adversary's turns (including Elite Actions), take 1d12 necrotic damage, which cannot be resisted or reduced by any means. (This can be ended as a bonus action on the user's turn or when it falls unconscious.)

name: Eight Inner Gates (3)
description: *Must have Eight Inner Gates (2) active. As an action, activate your Eight Inner Gates (3), ending Inner Gates (2). Gain +10 bonus points to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution, triple movement speed, and two additional actions. At the start of each of the adversary's turns (including Elite and Legendary Actions), take 3d12 necrotic damage, which cannot be resisted or reduced by any means. (This cannot be ended.)

name: Elemental Protection
description: Select two damage types. Gain resistance to the selected damage types. Select one damage type. Gain vulnerability to the chosen damage type.

name: Endurance
description: Chakra points increased by 30%.

name: Enhanced Nature Release
description: Pick 1 nature release. Increase the damage die of the chosen nature release by 1/6th of your level.

name: Escape
description: When you would be reduced to 0 hit points outside of your lair, you instead escape and flee to your lair. You remain there, paralyzed and resting, until you recover at least 50% of your hit points.

name: Evasive
description: When subjected to a Dexterity saving throw, if you would pass, you instead take no damage and suffer no effects.

name: Expert Elementalist
description: Select one elemental damage type. Increase damage done with the chosen damage type by +2 damage dice and gain immunity to the chosen damage type. You gain vulnerability to the nature release's superior element.

name: Expert Seal Weaver
keywords: Attack, Defense, Control, Mobility, Utility, Buff, General
description: Twice per combat, you can cast one Ninjutsu or Genjutsu with a casting time of 1 action as a bonus action.

name: Expert Sensory Shinobi
description: If a creature has chakra and is within 100 miles of you, you can sense it and know its general location.

name: False Appearance
description: +5 bonus to Deception, Performance, and Persuasion. (Automatically added.)

name: Flight
description: You can fly your speed. While flying, you must move your entire movement speed or land, unless you can also hover. Launching into flight provokes opportunity attacks, even if you Disengage.

name: Force of Will
description: When subjected to a Wisdom saving throw, if you would pass, you instead take no damage and suffer no effects.

name: Fortuitous
description: When subjected to a Constitution saving throw, if you would pass, you instead take no damage and suffer no effects.

name: Freedom of Movement
description: Immunity to difficult terrain and speed reduction effects.

name: Grappler
description: Advantage on attack rolls against any target currently grappled. In addition, while grappling a target, any damage you take from an attack or jutsu is split 50/50 evenly with the grappled creature.

name: Great Weapon Master
description: While wielding a weapon with two hands, this adversary can choose to take a -5 penalty to its attack roll, gaining a +10 bonus to damage rolls, once per turn.

name: Grimy
description: When you hit a creature with a melee or ranged weapon attack, you may spend your bonus action to disarm it, immediately taking its weapon away from it if it had one equipped, or if it has one visible on its person.

name: Guerilla
description: When you make a ranged attack while hidden, you don't reveal yourself and can remain hidden so long as you do not move more than half your full movement and remain obscured in some way.

name: Healer
description: When you would heal a creature, you double the die used to restore hit points.

name: Heavy Weapon Expert
description: While wielding a weapon with the heavy weapon property, add 2d4 to all damage rolls made with the weapon. (Already added.)

name: Honorable
description: When initiative is rolled, mark 1 hostile creature. A creature marked in this way remains marked for the duration of this encounter or until killed. An unconscious creature loses any marks. Only one creature can be marked at a time. While a creature is marked, add 1d4 to attack and damage rolls against the marked creature and suffer a 1d6 penalty to attack and damage rolls against creatures that are not marked.

name: Immortal
description: You cannot be killed unless you are reduced to 0 hit points by a specific damage type or type of attack. Any other form of attack or damage will reduce you to 1 hit point instead.

name: Immutable Form
description: You are immune to any jutsu or effect that would alter your form.

name: Improved Critical
description: Critical hits increase their damage die by 1/6th of your level.

name: Incorporeal
description: As a bonus action, you can become incorporeal. While incorporeal, you can pass through any solid non-chakra-based matter and cannot be harmed by Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, or Bukijutsu. This includes Class Mod Arts that would require physical interaction by any means. A creature can only remain incorporeal until the beginning of its next turn.

name: Indomitable
description: You are immune to any effects that would alter your mind or will. This includes Charmed and Fear. You cannot be mind-controlled or influenced by external forces.

name: Inscrutable
description: You are immune to any effect that would sense your emotions, read your thoughts, or sense your intentions.

name: Inspiring Leader
description: As an action, you can command your allies in initiative, bolstering their resolve. All allies gain your level + your proficiency bonus in temporary hit points for the next minute. Recharge (5-6).

name: Invisible
description: You cannot be seen by normal means. You can only be seen or sensed as a result of a Sensory jutsu or special sight such as Chakra Sight or True Sight. A creature that attempts to cast Uzumaki Break or Dispel Chakra against you temporarily disables this trait for 1d4 turns.

name: Iron Fist
description: The first Taijutsu or unarmed attack you make each turn adds +1d4 to the attack and damage rolls.

name: Iron Mind
description: Advantage on Intelligence saving throws and ability checks.

name: Kage Support
description: The Help action can target up to 2 allied creatures, up to 30 feet away.

name: Lethal Hunter
description: Ranged weapon attacks gain a +1 bonus to their damage die, and damage dealt with a ranged Taijutsu attack using that weapon increases by 1 die.
notes: Printed twice, at the end of p.68 and the top of p.69, with identical text; transcribed once.

name: Life Eater
description: When you deal damage that reduces a creature to 0 hit points, that creature cannot be revived by any means.

name: Light Weapon Expert
description: While wielding a weapon with the light weapon property, make 1 additional attack.

name: Lion Fist
description: As a bonus action, select one creature within 60 feet, forcing it to make a Wisdom saving throw against your highest save DC. On a failure, it gains one rank of the Fear condition against you for the next minute. A feared creature can spend its action to remake the save in an attempt to remove all ranks of Fear it currently has as a result of this trait.

name: Long Lasting Grudge
description: Select one Hidden Village or country. You gain a bonus to attack and damage against creatures from that village or country equal to 1/6th of your level.

name: Martial Advantage
description: Once per turn, deal extra damage equal to half your level when you hit a target creature while within 5 ft. of allied creatures.

name: Medic Adept
description: You cannot lose concentration on a jutsu with the Medical keyword as a result of damage.

name: Medic Expert
description: Twice per combat, as an action, you can automatically end any condition affecting an allied creature. Additionally, jutsu with the Medical keyword that restore hit points cannot be reacted to.

name: Medic Master
description: Twice per combat, as an action, all allied creatures within 30 feet of you regain 50 hit points.

name: Mist Sight
description: You can see in any form of mist, smoke, haze, or obscuring gases, even if made as a result of a jutsu.

name: Parry
description: As a reaction, gain +3 AC against all melee attacks that you can see until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Poisoner
description: Poison damage you deal deals additional damage equal to your level, once per turn.

name: Power of Age
description: Select 2 damage types. Ignore resistance and immunity to the chosen damage types and gain a +2 bonus to critical threat range with the chosen damage types. Select 3 damage types; gain vulnerability to the chosen damage types. This vulnerability cannot be removed or counteracted.

name: Power of Ignorance
description: Select 1 ability score. Automatically pass all saves with the chosen ability score. Select 2 ability scores. Automatically fail all saves with the chosen ability scores. This vulnerability cannot be removed or counteracted.

name: Power of Pride
description: Select 2 conditions. Gain immunity to the chosen conditions. Select 3 conditions. Gain vulnerability to the chosen conditions. This vulnerability cannot be removed or counteracted.

name: Power of Youth
description: While Bloodied (50% HP), roll 1d10 at the beginning of each of your turns. On a roll of 7-10, regain 1/5th of your level in d12 hit points and chakra.

name: Powerful Penetration
description: Select one damage type. Ignore resistance to the chosen damage type.

name: Protect the Young
description: While standing next to a younger or lower-classed/ranked ally, you can spend a reaction to redirect an attack to yourself.

name: Puppet Tool
description: (This trait does not count against your known trait slots.) You are a Puppet, designed to serve the will of your Puppet Master. You do not have turns. Instead, the Puppet Master controls you to take your turn by spending either its action, bonus action, or an amount of chakra equal to your adversary rank (D-Rank: 3, C-Rank: 6, B-Rank: 9, A-Rank: 12, S-Rank: 15). You can take a reaction without any input from your Puppet Master. If your Puppet Master is unable to take actions, you cannot take actions either.

name: Ranged Weapon Expert
description: While wielding a ranged weapon or a weapon with the thrown property, you can make +1 additional attack with the Attack action. (Already added.)

name: Redirect
description: When you are within 5 ft. of another creature, if you are the target of a melee attack, you can spend a reaction. When you do, make a Dexterity saving throw against the attacker's attack save DC (its Taijutsu save DC if the attack is unarmed or with a weapon). On a success, you redirect the attack to another creature within 5 feet of you, regardless of whether it is an ally or hostile.

name: Regeneration
description: You regain 1/10th of your maximum hit points at the start of each of your turns. This regeneration stops for 1 turn if you are hit by a specific damage type (select one) or you are reduced to 0 hit points.

name: Siege Master
description: Deal quadruple damage to objects, structures, and constructs.

name: Self Destruct
description: When your hit points fall to 0, you detonate due to a dead man's switch. All creatures within 20 feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw against your highest save DC, taking a number of d4s of fire damage equal to your level on a failure, or half as much on a success.

name: Sensory Shinobi
description: If a creature has chakra and is within 1 mile of you, you can sense it and know its general location.

name: Shinobi Slayer
description: When a hostile creature would attempt to cast a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu, with or without hand signs, while within 15 feet, as a reaction, move up to 15 feet to engage the creature, then make a single melee weapon attack. On a hit, the target must make a Constitution saving throw against your Taijutsu save DC. On a failed save, it loses the attempted jutsu while still spending the chakra.

name: Silent Fist
description: Attacks of opportunity you make are made with advantage. Creatures cannot react to your first unarmed attack each turn.

name: Split
description: When you are bloodied, you split into two smaller copies. Each new copy has hit points equal to half of your remaining hit points and acts independently.

name: Stolen Kekkei Genkai
description: You can select up to 2 additional clan traits from any clan you choose.

name: Strength of Will
description: Advantage on Wisdom saving throws and ability checks.

name: Strong Arm
description: Advantage on Strength saving throws and ability checks.

name: Sure-Footed
description: Advantage on Dexterity saving throws and ability checks.

name: Swarm
description: You can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. You gain advantage on attacks against any creature that shares your space.

name: Synchronized Hivemind
description: For each allied creature in initiative that shares this trait, you gain +2 to Perception.

name: Teamwork
description: You have advantage on attack rolls when the target is within 5 ft. of you and an unrestrained ally.

name: Terrain Advantage
description: Immunity to difficult terrain. Gain a +10 bonus to speed while in an area of difficult terrain.

name: Thermal Vision
description: This adversary is always under the effect of the Heated Sight jutsu, as it uses thermal vision to hunt prey.

name: Tough
description: Advantage on Constitution saving throws and ability checks.

name: Toxic Chakra
description: If you would take chakra damage or a creature would absorb your chakra, the triggering creature must make a Constitution saving throw against your highest save DC. On a failed save, it takes 2 poison damage per chakra point damaged or absorbed.

name: Uncanny Senses
description: Immune to the Surprised condition. +5 bonus to Perception. (Automatically added.)

name: Undying Fortitude
description: If damage reduces you to 0 hit points, make a Constitution saving throw with a DC equal to the damage taken. On a success, you drop to 1 hit point instead.

name: Unlimited Potential
description: When you Clash with a creature, you roll with advantage and the opposing creature makes its check with disadvantage.

name: Unrestrainable
description: Immunity to the Restrained and Grappled conditions.

name: Untainted Focus
description: You can concentrate on up to 3 jutsu at once.

name: Versatile Weapon Expert
description: While wielding a weapon with the versatile weapon property, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with the weapon. Additionally, if you make more than one weapon attack with the versatile weapon in the same action and hit with both attacks against the same creature, the target of the attacks gains 1 stack of Bleeding.

name: Zenith
keywords: Attack, Defense, Control, Mobility, Buff, General
description: All of your jutsu are automatically upcast by 1 rank.

name: Tenacious Tenacity
description: (This trait may only be taken by an Elite or Solo adversary.) This adversary now uses d6s for its Tenacity Die. If this adversary is not Iconic or Epic, reduce its maximum Tenacity Die by half.
